title: Electrocardiography Protocol for Mice
author: Anil Singapuri
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yidfua6

steps.title: Anesthetize and Ventilate Mice
steps.instruction: Anesthetize mice and establish mechanical ventilation.

substeps.instruction: Administer intraperitoneal ketamine (100 mg/kg) and xylazine (5 mg/kg).
Intubate and mechanically ventilate with supplemental oxygen at a respiratory rate of 100 breaths/min and a tidal volume of 0.2 ml.

steps.title: Prepare Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Clear and disinfect the surgical area.

substeps.instruction: Remove fur from surgical incision sites using Nair.
Clean the skin with Betadine, followed by 70% alcohol 3 times.

steps.title: Set Up Sterile Environment
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and maintain animal homeostasis.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a clean, disinfected lab bench with autoclaved sterile instruments.
Place mice on a sterilized cloth on a circulating water blanket to maintain body temperature.
Surgeons must scrub with Betadine, wear a mask, and use sterile gloves.

steps.title: Implant ECG Transmitter
steps.instruction: Surgically place the ECG transmitter in the peritoneal cavity.

substeps.instruction: Make a 10-mm incision in the abdomen.
Place a sterile ECG transmitter (Data Sciences International, volume=2.1 cc, weight=3.4 g) within the peritoneal cavity.
Secure the transmitter to the inside wall of the abdomen using non-absorbable sutures.

steps.title: Position ECG Leads
steps.instruction: Secure the ECG leads to the body.

substeps.instruction: Tunnel the two ECG leads subcutaneously.
Tie the leads to the right shoulder and the xyphoid space caudal to the ribcage.

steps.title: Close Incisions
steps.instruction: Suture the abdominal wall and skin.

substeps.instruction: Close the abdominal muscle with 6-0 Nylon sterile sutures.
Close the skin with 4-0 absorbable sutures (Ethilon).

steps.title: Administer Post-Operative Analgesia
steps.instruction: Provide pain management via subcutaneous injection.

substeps.instruction: Administer a bolus injection of 0.1 mg/kg of buprenorphine subcutaneously.

steps.title: Record ECG Signals
steps.instruction: Collect continuous ECG data from the subjects.

substeps.instruction: Record signals in freely moving mice in their home cage at various time periods.
